text:
cloud-ops: Quick ask — we're hitting multiple storage/network limits in the inference-gpu-prod account (us-west-2) during scale-outs. Need quota bumps and a short-term workaround plan.

raj: Which exact quotas and account? list numbers please.

cloud-ops: Account: 987654321000. Problems: snapshot copy concurrency throttles during nightly cross-region copies, attach throughput spikes on gp3 volumes during pod startup (cold KV cache), and NAT GW egress saturating which delays docker pulls for new nodes. Current observed: ~1.2 GB/s aggregate snapshot copy to us-east-1 throttled to ~200 MB/s, attach ops causing tail latencies up to 600ms.

maria: Can you propose target increases and any immediate mitigations we can do to avoid infra changes?

cloud-ops: Proposed changes: 1) EBS provisioned IOPS aggregate quota from 40,000 -> 180,000 for us-west-2 (we're provisioning many gp3 volumes with high iops). 2) Concurrent snapshot copy limit from 10 -> 60 for account (cross-region transfer). 3) EC2 network interface / ENI quota per AZ from 1000 -> 2000 (p4d/p5 scale). 4) NAT Gateway bandwidth request / guidance: current single NAT per AZ ~10 Gbps observed, request guidance + temporary request for a soft increase to support ~40 Gbps egress or approval to deploy additional NATs / TGW. 5) Increase of p4d instance limit from 20 -> 60 to allow capacity growth.

kelsey: For 1 and 2 we should also include IO profile and cost sign-off. Finance needs a ballpark for snapshot egress and accelerated throughput costs. @finance can you pre-approve a one-time bump for snapshot transfer?

finance: We can approve up to $4k one-time for cross-region snapshot transfer this month if engineering confirms this is temporary and documents expected recurring cost.

cloud-ops: Thanks. Short-term mitigations: - Stagger snapshot jobs across time windows (already started). - Use fast snapshot restore (FSR) for hottest volumes to reduce attach latency. - Switch some critical volumes to io2 for more consistent IOPS where throughput matters (but higher $). - Add an extra NAT per AZ and route heavy image pulls through a dedicated ECR mirror in us-west-2 to reduce cross-AZ egress.

raj: Please open Service Quotas requests + AWS Support case with the attached graphs (I/O and snapshot latency) and include the account id and business justification (inference fleet scale, customer SLAs).

cloud-ops: Will do. Creating service-quotas CLI requests and support case now. Command snippets I'm using: ```bash
aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase --service-code ebs --quota-code L-12345 --desired-value 180000 --region us-west-2
aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-67890 --desired-value 2000 --region us-west-2
aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-54321 --desired-value 60 --region us-west-2
```

cloud-ops: Filed AWS support case for snapshot throttling and io2 availability: CASE-2026-000123 (support portal link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/home?region=us-west-2#/case/CASE-2026-000123).

devops-bot: AWS support case created: CASE-2026-000123, service: EBS, severity: normal, ticket id: 1234567890. (Automated update will post here).

sre-oncall: After quotas land we should run a controlled canary: 10 nodes scale-up, attach volumes with FSR, validate tail latency under load, and monitor snapshot throughput while doing cross-region copy. Schedule window?

cloud-ops: Suggested window: tonight 02:00–04:00 UTC for canary. I'll also implement staggered snapshot schedule and add temporary NATs. Will update this thread with service-quotas request ids once returned.

maria: Please add the expected rollback plan in the ticket: reduce scale if attach latencies > 300ms, revert to gp3 with lower iops or freeze auto-scaling.

cloud-ops: ack. Adding rollback notes and cost estimate to support case.

devops-bot: Service Quotas requests submitted: Request IDs: SQ-req-9981 (EBS IOPS), SQ-req-9982 (Snapshot concurrency), SQ-req-9983 (ENI), SQ-req-9984 (p4d limit). You should get email updates from AWS.

raj: Thanks — please paste the request emails here when they arrive so we can track.

cloud-ops: Will do. For visibility I'm attaching the small dashboard snapshot link: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/infra/ebs-snapshots?orgId=1&from=-6h (shows 600ms tail attach latencies).

finance: Please track incremental transfer costs to cost center INFRA-GPU. Approved as one-off; need a follow-up for recurring increase.

cloud-ops: Plan: (1) wait for quota approvals, (2) deploy 1 extra NAT per AZ and ECR mirror today, (3) run canary during maint window, (4) scale fleet after green.

kelsey: Sounds good. Please @raj if any pushback from AWS and escalate to account team. :thumbsup:
